text: 你和西尔维娅一起挣扎着游到岸边。安全上岸后，你们松开彼此，躺着仰望天空，大口喘气，等诺曼赶来。
你对学术的执着逐渐消退。你们冒着生命危险究竟为了什么？只是进入一个很可能空无一物的箱形峡谷吗？探险队已一团糟。该结束了。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 533
text: Together, you and Sylvia struggle to the shore. Safe on dry land, you disengage and lie staring into the sky, gasping for breath and waiting for Norman to join you.
Your academic commitment fades. For what purpose have you been risking your lives? To enter what is probably an empty box canyon? The expedition is in a shambles. It’s time you ended it.
